notes: Printed -7 emblem: 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, ...'. Turn 1 (mine): the opponent's Opp Beast returns under my control with haste and attacks for 2 (20 -> 18), then dies back to its owner's graveyard. Turn 2 is the opponent's: their beginning of combat must NOT trigger my emblem, so Opp Beast is still in their graveyard at the end of their turn.
